اعتطفتا (form VIII)
# اِعْتَطَفَتَا (iʕtaṭafatā) /iʕ.ta.tˤa.fa.taː/: third-person feminine dual past active of اِعْتَطَفَ (iʕtaṭafa)
# اُعْتُطِفَتَا (uʕtuṭifatā) /uʕ.tu.tˤi.fa.taː/: third-person feminine dual past passive of اِعْتَطَفَ (iʕtaṭafa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
